proximityEnabled.Name: Proximity Awareness
proximityEnabled.Hint: Allied tokens close to one of your tokens stay visible, even outside line of sight or in darkness.

proximityRange.Name: Proximity Range (grid spaces)
proximityRange.Hint: How close an ally must be, measured between token centers, to stay visible.

proximityTargets.Name: Proximity Targets
proximityTargets.Hint: Which tokens are kept visible by proximity. Tokens with a secret disposition are never revealed.

proximityWallsBlock.Name: Walls Block Proximity
proximityWallsBlock.Hint: If enabled, a sight-blocking wall between two tokens prevents proximity awareness.

lastKnownEnabled.Name: Last Known Positions
lastKnownEnabled.Hint: When a tracked token leaves your sight, mark where it was last seen and the direction it was heading.

lastKnownDispositions.Name: Tracked Tokens
lastKnownDispositions.Hint: Which tokens leave a last known position marker. Tokens you own are never tracked.
lastKnownDispositions.All: All tokens you do not own

lastKnownShare.Name: Share Sightings With Party
lastKnownShare.Hint: When one player loses sight of a token, the marker is shared with every other player.

lastKnownLifetime.Name: Marker Lifetime (rounds)
lastKnownLifetime.Hint: Remove markers after this many rounds. Outside combat, elapsed game time is converted to rounds. Set to 0 to keep markers until the token is seen again.

lastKnownShowGM.Name: Show Markers to GM
lastKnownShowGM.Hint: Track last known positions for the GM while the GM is controlling tokens.

lastKnownStyle.Name: Marker Appearance
lastKnownStyle.Label: Customize Markers
lastKnownStyle.Hint: Choose how last known position markers look for every player: color, outline, image, label, size and opacity.

ClearMarkers.Name: Clear Last Known Positions
ClearMarkers.Hint: Remove all last known position markers on the current scene.

Preset.Name: Preset
Preset.Hint: Fill in the form with a ready-made style for a kind of game world. Adjust it if you like, then save.

color.Name: Custom Color
color.Hint: Used when Color is set to Custom color.

scale.Name: Size
scale.Hint: Marker size relative to the token that was seen.

ringWidth.Name: Outline Thickness
ringWidth.Hint: Thickness as a fraction of the grid size.

fillOpacity.Name: Fill Opacity
fillOpacity.Hint: Opacity of the fill inside the shape. Set to 0 for no fill.

imagePath.Name: Custom Image
imagePath.Hint: Used when Image is set to Custom image. Use it to hide what was seen, for example with a question mark icon.

labelText.Name: Custom Label
labelText.Hint: Used when Label is set to Custom text. {rounds} is replaced with the number of rounds since the sighting.

animationSpeed.Name: Animation Cycle (seconds)
animationSpeed.Hint: How long one pulse or one full turn takes.
